#!/bin/bash

# System cleanup and update check script
# To install: sudo cp cron_cleanup.sh /etc/cron.hourly/cleanup && sudo chmod +x /etc/cron.hourly/cleanup

# Perform system cleanup
apt autoremove -y
apt autoclean -y

# Check for system updates
UPDATES=$(apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null | grep -v "Listing..." | wc -l)

# Report back to management server
if [ "$UPDATES" -gt 0 ]; then
    UPDATE_LIST=$(apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null | grep -v "Listing...")
    REPORT_DATA="{\"hostname\": \"$(hostname)\", \"updates_available\": $UPDATES, \"update_list\": \"$UPDATE_LIST\", \"timestamp\": \"$(date -Iseconds)\"}"
    
    # Send report to management server (replace with your actual endpoint)
    curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
         -d "$REPORT_DATA" \
         http://management-server.example.com/api/reports 2>/dev/null || echo "Failed to send report to management server"
else
    echo "No updates available"
fi

# Log completion
logger "Hourly cleanup and update check completed: $UPDATES updates available"
